name: Besseleth's Fang
summary: In Sishir Canyon, Besseleth's Fang marks the end of a deadly spider's threat.

sections.title: Trophy of the Canyon Stalker
sections.body: Besseleth and her brood make Sishir Canyon dangerous for travelers. At night, the giant spider turns the Webwinder Path into a death trap for those crossing the gorge. Her fang measures nearly two feet and drips with potent venom. Local defenders have suffered her venomous strikes, and presenting the fang brings them relief.

faq.q: What is Besseleth's Fang used for?
faq.answer: The fang proves that Besseleth, the spider matriarch, has been slain. Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat placed a bounty on her after surviving a near-fatal attack by her fangs, and rewards anyone who brings him the trophy.

faq.q: Where does this fang come from?
faq.answer: The fang comes from Besseleth, a giant predatory spider dwelling inside Sishir Canyon. The canyon lies west of the main road south of Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Why did Maggran Earthbinder want Besseleth dead?
faq.answer: Besseleth and her brood prey on travelers heading along the roads toward Sun Rock Retreat, especially at night. After Besseleth ambushed and wounded him with her fangs, Maggran Earthbinder issued a bounty to secure the trails.

faq.q: Who posted the bounty for the fang?
faq.answer: Maggran Earthbinder authorized the bounty. A wanted sign warning travelers of Sishir Canyon's hazards stands along the main roadway south of the Windshear Crag fork.

angles.text: Clearing the canyon spider helps safeguard the precarious mountain trails connecting the Barrens border with Sun Rock Retreat.
As a hunter, you can claim the venomous tooth of an apex arachnid matriarch, nearly two feet long, as proof of your tracking and combat prowess.
